notes:
Account snapshot: CodaQuarry is a mid-market marketplace SaaS building product discovery for vertical marketplaces. Early evaluation started on Hosted API for speed-to-value; after initial tests they are leaning toward Dedicated to hit predictable latency and unit-cost targets for production search. Primary focus is reranking: they want a dedicated rerank endpoint that accepts candidate lists + feature vectors and returns reorder scores. They also need robust offline scoring for large eval sets (scale: ~5M pairs), and tooling to run evals and tune relevance configs (nDCG, MRR tracking).

Recent timeline / activity (bulleted):
- 2025-11-05: inbound trial signup, initial self-serve tests of Hosted API (basic generation + embeddings).
- 2026-01-20: deep-dive call (AE Priya + SE Marco) — demoed basic rerank flow using sample dataset (see ff_20260120_2109). Customer liked per-request feature passthrough.
- 2026-02-14: POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_20260214_3571). Customer uploaded eval set (5k queries with labelled relevance); asked for offline scoring guidance and batching recommendations.
- 2026-02-27: Security questionnaire submitted to Redwood. Questions focused on KMS integration, audit log retention, and EU region residency.
- 2026-03-01: Internal procurement discussion; asked for a 6-month Dedicated trial pricing proposal and throughput sizing.

POC / technical requirements (short):
- Rerank endpoint that accepts: candidate ids, retrieval scores, dense vector features, and returns re-ranked list with scores + confidence.
- Latency targets: p95 <= 120ms for rerank of top-50 candidates (target under Dedicated).
- Throughput: baseline 200 qps peak, sustained 50 qps; ability to burst to 600 qps for sales events.
- Offline scoring: ingest eval sets and run batch scoring of ~5M pairs within 48 hours; export scores for offline analysis.
- Metrics required: nDCG@10, MRR, p95 latency, cost-per-query, model-version attribution.
- Routing/fallback: prefer Dedicated for production; fallback to Hosted API in another region if capacity exhausted.

Security & compliance notes:
- SOC2 required; SSO/SAML for product admin console; KMS-managed keys for any customer-sensitive artifacts; audit logging with 12 month retention.
- EU data residency requirement for a subset of customer data (legal review pending).

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Mid-market buyer; cost sensitive. Interested in a 6-month reserved Dedicated trial (reduced commit) to validate latency and unit economics before an annual commit. Ask pricing team for a dual-offer: Hosted consumption + 6mo Dedicated trial at 40% discount on list Dedicated rates.

Quotes / paraphrases from meetings:
- "We need deterministic latency for product-critical search — p95 spikes are a showstopper." — Head of Product.
- "Offline scoring throughput will determine whether we can run nightly re-tunes. If it takes weeks, won't work." — Engineering Lead.

POC deliverables & acceptance criteria:
- Demo of rerank endpoint with customer's eval set (baseline to improved nDCG@10 >= +6% over current in-house model).
- Offline scoring job run end-to-end and results returned as CSV / BigQuery export.
- Security checklist items validated (SOC2 evidence, SSO test account, KMS demo).

Next steps (short):
- Schedule focused rerank endpoint demo (requested week of 2026-03-08).
- Send POC guide with sample request payloads, batching guidance, and offline scoring job template.
- Deliver Dedicated trial pricing + capacity plan by 2026-03-05.

Open blockers: security questionnaire outstanding (SEC-3912), legal sign-off on EU residency approach, and Q2 budget window for commit.
